title: Jesse's France trip and the Before Sunset synchronicity
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jesse's France trip and the Before Sunset synchronicity, about an unknown time at Paris, France, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and so the next day on a whim I book a trip to France and I end up being there for the whole summer and in Paris I end up dating a girl

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that one day, on a whim, he booked a trip to France, ended up staying the whole summer, and started dating a girl in Paris. He tells it as a synchronicity, a meaningful coincidence, tied to Before Sunset, a film by the director Richard Linklater. He shares it in a talk about coincidences and dreams that seem to foretell events.
